guildId.description: Limit bot to a specific server. Right-click server → Copy Server ID.

instructions: Go to Discord Developer Portal → Applications → New Application
In Bot section: Add Bot, then copy the Bot Token
Enable Message Content Intent + Server Members Intent in Bot → Privileged Gateway Intents
In OAuth2 → URL Generator: select "bot" + "applications.commands", add message permissions
Invite the bot to your server using the generated URL
Paste the bot token below

feishu.description: Connect a Feishu/Lark bot via the Feishu official plugin, either by QR creation or an existing app
instructions: LawClaw installs the Feishu official plugin online and starts the official bot-creation flow.
Click "Start Bot Creation" and wait for the QR code to appear.
Scan the QR code with Feishu to create a bot and bind App ID / App Secret automatically.
After creation, LawClaw writes the default Feishu channel config and restarts the gateway automatically.

openclaw-weixin.description: Connect Weixin through the Tencent openclaw-weixin plugin with QR binding and binding removal support
instructions: LawClaw installs the openclaw-weixin plugin online.
Click "Generate QR Code" and wait for the Weixin binding QR code to appear.
Scan it with Weixin to bind the current LawClaw instance.
If you need to bind again, delete the binding first to clear the current openclaw.json config, then generate a new QR code.
